Entries.Title: A Dream Within a Dream
Entries.Description: When Song Xiaoyu is unexpectedly pulled into a scripted world as a tragic heroine fated to be discarded by the villainous male lead, she tries to escape, only to be trapped in an endless loop of fatal outcomes each time she strays from the plot. No matter how hard she resists, the story keeps pushing her toward Nan Heng, the cold and calculating lead. As she navigates this paper-thin world where every character is bound by fate, Song Xiaoyu must fight not just for her survival, but for control over her own story.

Episodes.Title: Becoming the Female Lead
Episodes.Description: During the script-reading for a period drama, Song Xiaoyu feels that it's unfair for Song Yimeng, the female lead. On the other hand, a click on the keyboard sends Song Xiaoyu into the script of Dream of Qingning.

Episodes.Title: Six Months before the Wedding
Episodes.Description: After crossing over into Song Yimeng's body, Song Xiaoyu is surprised to find out that she has arrived six months before her wedding. It seems she now has enough time to gradually change the course of the story.

Episodes.Title: Love Line
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng jumps into the water as soon as he hears Song Yimeng falling into the water. While Song Yimeng is struggling, she sees Nan Heng who looks exactly like Nan Feng. Her first reaction is to never go through the plot with him.

Episodes.Title: Stalling Tactic
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng doesn't know that Nan Heng is determined to kill her. She tries to bargain for her life with the Duan Blade Technique.

Episodes.Title: Law of Mutual Rescue
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng intends to be on good terms with Chu Guihong, who was just released from prison. She tells him how Nan Heng is going to put him on the spot in the imperial court.

Episodes.Title: Assassin
Episodes.Description: Fading River Moon is a guild hall opened in the capital by Nan Heng three years ago in secret. He has another secret identity, which is...

Episodes.Title: Playing Along
Episodes.Description: Shangguan He advises Nan Heng to use his identity as Li Shiliu to get closer to Song Yimeng and sabotage the marriage alliance between the Song and Chu families.

Episodes.Title: Two Li Shi Liu
Episodes.Description: The real and fake Li Shiliu duke it out in Fading River Moon until the real one knocks the mask off of Chu Guihong. Only then could the people see...

Episodes.Title: Everyone Has Their Own Agenda
Episodes.Description: Li Shiliu watches as Song Yimeng lets the scroll of the Plan to Kill Heng, covered in writing, slip to the ground. A flicker of tension tightens between his brows.

Episodes.Title: A Wish
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng watches Song Yimeng make a wish sincerely. He tells Song Yimeng that if she can help him get the Duan Blade Technique, no matter what her wish is, he'll help her fulfill it.

Episodes.Title: Fire in the Southern District
Episodes.Description: Concerned about the raging fire at the oil mill, Li Shiliu leads the members of Fading River Moon into the heart of the blaze to help.

Episodes.Title: Once Friends
Episodes.Description: Under the guise of his dual identity, Nan Heng joins Song Yimeng in rebuilding the southern district. In the process, he finally uncovers the reason behind her hatred toward him.

Episodes.Title: Cracking the Secret Symbol
Episodes.Description: When Nan Heng visits his mother, Noble Consort Gao, he accidentally finds clues about the Duan Blade Technique in her old belongings.

Episodes.Title: A Public Proposal
Episodes.Description: Song Yi Meng is in love with Li Shiliu. She refuses to marry Chu Gui Hong.

Episodes.Title: Expressing One's Feelings
Episodes.Description: The emperor interrogates Song Yimeng for instigating the two princes into starting a conflict. To protect Song Yimeng, Nan Heng barges into the imperial study room and bears the blame.

Episodes.Title: Immortal under the Moonlight
Episodes.Description: Li Shiliu pays a secret visit to the Song Residence at late night. As he departs, his striking figure beneath the moonlight catches Song Yiting's eye and sparks her curiosity.

Episodes.Title: Granted Marriage
Episodes.Description: To protect Chu Guihong, the emperor makes a deal with Nan Heng to cancel the marriage between the Song and the Chu families. Nan Heng and Song Yimeng feel happy about the decision but the emperor also grants a marriage between Nan Heng and Song Yimeng.

Episodes.Title: Changing Fate
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng wants to kill Nan Heng again. She has made up her mind to protect the Song family from getting wiped out by Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: Concubine
Episodes.Description: Noble Consort Gao invites a group of noble ladies and their daughters to Fanghua Hall. She says that she's going to help Nan Heng choose a concubine. In reality, she's trying to stir Song Yimeng's feelings for Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: Offense and Defense
Episodes.Description: To keep her sister from being deceived by Nan Heng, Song Yimeng resolves to take action against him.

Episodes.Title: Last Farewell
Episodes.Description: Shangguan He tells Li Shiliu everything about the blade and Song Yiting. Li Shiliu wants Shangguan He to disguise himself as Li Shiliu for one last time tomorrow and retrieve the blade.

Episodes.Title: A Do-Or-Die Plan
Episodes.Description: Zhou Xueyi continues to force Song Yiting to get married. She has had enough and decides to have a union with Li Shiliu when he comes for the sword. Nan Heng dresses up as Li Shiliu to meet her. He then realizes that Song Yiting has lit a drugged incense that causes him to be paralyzed.

Episodes.Title: Identity Revealed
Episodes.Description: The capital is trying to arrest the Night Wandering Gods. Li Shiliu goes to their hiding spot and announces their disbandment. But they think that he's trying to protect them by saving Shangguan He himself. Due to that, they aren't willing to leave.

Episodes.Title: Atone with His Life
Episodes.Description: Learning Shangguan He is going to be executed, Song Yiting asks Song Yimeng for help.

Episodes.Title: Let Go of Yourself
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng is stopped by Nan Heng as she leaves the execution ground. She refuses to listen to his explanation and instead demands that he give an answer to the Night Wandering Gods, who were still desperately defending him even on the eve of the execution.

Episodes.Title: Assassination
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng rushes over when he finds out that Song Yimeng is in danger. He fights the men in black despite his injuries.

Episodes.Title: Destiny Can Be Changed
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng hears about Gao Changying's death. Song Yude says that the rumors circulating in the Capital have pinpointed Nan Heng as the culprit. Song Yimeng insists that Nan Heng won't do something like that.

Episodes.Title: Forced to Extremes
Episodes.Description: Long and Hu are caught and interrogated by Chu Guihong, who resorts to brutal torture just to make them testify against Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: Mastermind
Episodes.Description: Chu Guihong accuses Nan Heng of ordering the assassination of Luyi. Nan Heng refutes the claim, stating that the testimony is fabricated and that the witnesses can be summoned at any time for cross-examination.

Episodes.Title: Redemption
Episodes.Description: The Gao Residence has been sealed off. His accomplices and everyone in his party are exiled to Han Bei. Nan Heng returns the Tiger Tally of the Armored Soldiers to His Majesty. His Majesty hands him the Crown Prince appointment decree. Nan Heng refuses by saying that he has sinned.

Episodes.Title: World in a Storybook
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng arranges for a proposal at Fading River Moon. However, Song Yimeng rejects him unwillingly after his confession.

Episodes.Title: The Vow
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng brings Song Yimeng to the God of Matchmaker's Temple and vows to protect her and her family. Touched by his confession, Song Yimeng agrees to marry him.

Episodes.Title: New Life
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng wakes up from his injury. The emperor orders the Eastern Palace to be built on the side of the inner palace for Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: The Scripted World
Episodes.Description: Chu Guihong returns to the capital city with King Qian Yu. While Song Yimeng is waiting for Nan Heng at Fanghua Hall, she accidentally runs into King Qian Yu who calls himself the Screenwriter.

Episodes.Title: In a Different Light
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng takes King Qian Yu to Fading River Moon to let him experience the interesting place. At the same time, she tries to convince him to respect the characters and allow them to live as they please.

Episodes.Title: Fate
Episodes.Description: King Qian Yu tells Nan Heng that according to the rule of scripted world, anyone who changes their fate will suffer backlash.

Episodes.Title: Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng rushes into King Qian Yu's residence and asks him if he is involved in the poisoning of the emperor and the framing of Nan Rui...

Episodes.Title: Infinity Loop
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng wakes up from a dream-like death scene. She realizes that she is back at the crown prince's residence. She is thrilled when she sees that Nan Heng is still alive.

Episodes.Title: Launching a Pre-emptive Strike
Episodes.Description: Chu Guihong changes his plans. He frames Nan Heng in advance for the poisoned mandarins the Emperor was having. He intrudes upon the Emperor's bedchamber to do the deed.

Episodes.Title: Turning the Tide
Episodes.Description: The group sets up an ambush in the streets to intercept the Qianyu Army. King Qian Yu shows up and persuades the Qianyu soldiers to switch sides.

Entries.Title: Hotel Del Luna
Entries.Description: When he's invited to manage a hotel for dead souls, an elite hotelier gets to know the establishment's ancient owner and her strange world.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Hotel Del Luna
Episodes.Description: On a day when the full moon has risen, Hotel Del Luna resumes its business. Two guests visit the hotel. One is a female dead soul who used to be a policewoman, but ended up being drowned in the water. The other one is a man who isn’t technically dead yet, but somehow ended up being lost after running away from the police.

Episodes.Title: Catch a Tiger
Episodes.Description: Chan Seong keeps seeing the dead souls. He comes to visit Man Weol and tells her to make him not to see the ghosts anymore. However, he’s given a mission to complete, and that is to catch a tiger. Meanwhile, Manager No, the only human in Hotel Del Luna, retires from his position.

Episodes.Title: In a Dream
Episodes.Description: Chan Seong sees a woman in his dream, and the woman looks like Man Weol. Chan Seong wants to know about the history of Hotel Del Luna and Man Weol’s past, but the staff at the hotel wouldn’t tell him. Meanwhile, a dead soul that committed suicide by leaping from the overpass shows up in front of Chan Seong.

Episodes.Title: Room 13
Episodes.Description: Man Weol tells Chan Seong to take good care of her. As Man Weol opens her heart to Chan Seong, new leaves start to sprout from the Moon Tree. Such a change agitates Man Weol and the staff of the hotel. They start to think everything has begun to change after Chan Seong joined the hotel. Meanwhile, the door to Room 13 is finally opened.

Episodes.Title: Dead Bride's Wish
Episodes.Description: A dead bride’s spirit comes to visit Hotel Del Luna. Chan Seong kindly shows in the guest. Seeing him taking good care of the female guest makes Man Weol jealous and upset. Meanwhile, a red pocket is found at a park. Any man who picks up the red pocket has to get married to the bride’s spirit.

Episodes.Title: Chan-sung's Ex-girlfriend
Episodes.Description: Man Weol plans to go out for a meal with Chan Seong. However, she hears from Sanchez that Mi Ra, Chan Seong’s ex-girlfriend, has shown up. Man Weol starts to feel jealous. Meanwhile, the spirit of a king of Joseon Dynasty checks in to Hotel Del Luna. All the staff members do their best to make sure that he has a comfortable stay.

Episodes.Title: Rival in Love
Episodes.Description: The evil spirit that has escaped from Room 13 continues to harm men. The spirit gets closer to the one that she’s after. Chan Seong decides to become the bait himself to catch the spirit. Meanwhile, Man Weol runs into Mi Ra who had an ill-fated relationship with Man Weol in the previous life.

Episodes.Title: Man-wol and Princess Song-hwa
Episodes.Description: Chan Seong finds out why Man Weol is tied down to Hotel Del Luna. In dreams, he happens to see what happened between Man Weol and Princess Song Hwa in the past. Meanwhile, Man Weol invites Mi Ra to Hotel Del Luna and plans to torment her.

Episodes.Title: Where Are You, Man-wol?
Episodes.Description: Hotel Del Luna disappears overnight. Chan Seong begins to trace Man Weol. The hotel staffers are having difficulty in dealing with all the work without Chan Seong. Meanwhile, Hyun Joong and Yu Na meet a group of spirits in the mountains on their way to the new hotel.

Episodes.Title: Chairman Wang's Offer
Episodes.Description: Man Weol realizes that Yeon Woo has been reincarnated as a man named Yeong Su and is now a detective in this world. And Mi Ra runs into Yeong Su on the street. Meanwhile, Chairman Wang says that he would like to arrange a date between his granddaughter and Chan Seong. Will Chan Seong accept the offer?

Episodes.Title: Lunar Eclipse
Episodes.Description: Man Weol and Chan Seong start to date without telling anyone in the hotel. A lunar eclipse occurs in 39 years, and humans get to see the presence of Hotel Del Luna. To greet special guests visiting on the day of the lunar eclipse, Chan Seong opens the door of Room 404. Meanwhile, Seol Ji Won, the serial killer, looks for Yu Na.

Episodes.Title: Ill-fated Relationship
Episodes.Description: Chan Seong is attacked by the serial killer, Seol Ji Won. Man Weol keeps calling Chan Seong, but he won’t answer. Man Weol thinks that something bad has happened to him. Then, Yu Na tells that she has seen an ambulance take a man to the hospital. Everyone at the hotel starts to worry about Chan Seong.

Episodes.Title: Seo-hee's Resentment
Episodes.Description: The flowers in the hotel start withering. The staff of the hotel wonders if it’s time to prepare to leave for the afterlife. Meanwhile, Seo Hee recognizes a new male guest. She realizes that it is a chance to resolve her deep sorrow and resentment before going to the afterlife. Also, Seo Ji Won, who has become a vengeful spirit, begins to harass Chan Seong’s acquaintances.

Episodes.Title: Man-wol's Choice
Episodes.Description: Man Weol is obsessed with the thought that Chung Myung might have been reincarnated as Chan Seong. She finally faces a choice for Chan Seong. Meanwhile, Chan Seong and the Grim Reaper find where Seol Ji Won is. When they arrive at the place, they meet Man Weol. Chan Seong is curious about what Man Weol is up to.

Episodes.Title: Chan-sung's Time Travel
Episodes.Description: While crossing the bridge to the afterlife, Man Weol starts to forget her memories piece by piece. Will Man Weol come back to Chan Seong? Meanwhile, Chan Seong travels back in time and gets to meet Man Weol in Joseon Dynasty. He has to find a herb there and returns to Hotel Del Luna.

Episodes.Title: Time to Say Goodbye
Episodes.Description: The staffers at the hotel prepare to leave for the afterlife one by one. Man Weol sees them off herself and realizes that there isn’t much time left for her. She also prepares to leave. Meanwhile, Mr. Kim decides to leave for the afterlife before he gets humiliated by the book that the dead author wrote. Man Weol and Chan Seong come up with an idea of clearing Mr. Kim’s name.

Entries.Title: Sabrina, the Teenage Witch
Entries.Description: On her sixteenth birthday, Sabrina Spellman discovers she has magical powers. She lives with her 600-year-old aunts Hilda and Zelda as well as talking cat Salem in the fictional town of Westbridge, Massachusetts.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: On her sixteenth birthday, Sabrina Spellman finds out that she is a witch. However, instead of helping her, it actually makes life more difficult, especially after she gets on the wrong side of head cheerleader, Libby.

Episodes.Title: Bundt Friday
Episodes.Description: Sabrina slips Libby some truth sprinkles to make her confess to spreading nasty lies, but her plan backfires when the goodies make Jenny reveal she's sweet on Sabrina's love interest, Harvey. Meanwhile, Hilda prepares for a date with Drell - despite his having stood her up over 1,000 times in the past.

Episodes.Title: The True Adventures of Rudy Kazootie
Episodes.Description: In an attempt at earning some money to buy roller blades, Sabrina takes a job babysitting a little boy. However, when she is trying to calm him down, she inadvertently casts a spell which turns him into a man.

Episodes.Title: Terrible Things
Episodes.Description: Sabrina discovers that some of her closest friends have their own respective wishes, and she attempts to have all three of their desires granted.

Episodes.Title: A Halloween Story
Episodes.Description: Sabrina faces a frightful dilemma when she must be in two places at once for Halloween.

Episodes.Title: Dream Date
Episodes.Description: When Sabrina is left feeling down because Harvey has agreed to go to the school dance with Libby, her aunts literally cook up a date for her, but nonetheless she still pines for him.

Episodes.Title: Third Aunt From the Sun
Episodes.Description: Sabrina's zany Aunt Vesta pays her a visit and soon hatches a plot to entice her niece into moving to the Other Realm.

Episodes.Title: Magic Joel
Episodes.Description: In an effort to get Harvey's attention, Sabrina takes a job as a magician's assistant, but things go awry when she inadvertently makes the magician disappear.

Episodes.Title: Geek Like Me
Episodes.Description: Popular Libby manages to turn being a geek into a position of power.

Episodes.Title: Sweet and Sour Victory
Episodes.Description: Depressed by her lack of talent at sports, Sabrina casts a spell which makes her brilliant at Kung Fu, but when she beats a seasoned professional, her conscience bothers her.

Episodes.Title: A Girl and Her Cat
Episodes.Description: A Christmas Eve catnapping renews Salem's love for his family.

Episodes.Title: Trial by Fury
Episodes.Description: Sabrina and her aunts use magic to show an unfair teacher that what goes around comes around.

Episodes.Title: Jenny's Non-Dream
Episodes.Description: After spending the weekend at Jenny's, under the advice of her aunts, Sabrina reluctantly invites Jenny to her house. However, when Jenny enters the linen closet, she ends up in the Other Realm, at the mercy of Drell.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina Through the Looking Glass
Episodes.Description: Sabrina's in a foul mood and only baseball great Brady Anderson can help her out of her slump.

Episodes.Title: Hilda and Zelda: the Teenage Years
Episodes.Description: Aunts Hilda and Zelda experience growing pains when they turn into teenagers for the night.

Episodes.Title: Mars Attracts
Episodes.Description: Sabrina and her aunts take a trip to Mars, but Sabrina is reluctant to leave Harvey. She agrees to call him at a specified time, but when her attractive ski instructor takes a shine to her, she soon forgets about the mortal world.

Episodes.Title: First Kiss
Episodes.Description: As Sabrina and Harvey grow closer, her aunts reveal that when a witch kisses a mortal for the first time, the mortal turns into a frog. Unable to stop herself, however, Sabrina kisses Harvey, and must find a way to change him back.

Episodes.Title: Sweet Charity
Episodes.Description: When Sabrina uses Libby's likeness to promote a community service program, the real Libby manages to steal the limelight.

Episodes.Title: Cat Showdown
Episodes.Description: Salem enters a cat show to make some fast cash, but Sabrina uncovers a fur-raising scandal.

Episodes.Title: Meeting Dad's Girlfriend
Episodes.Description: Love definitely isn't in the air when Sabrina meets her dad's new girlfriend.

Episodes.Title: As Westbridge Turns
Episodes.Description: Sinister plots, tumultuous romance, danger, and intrigue - just another day at Westbridge High, after Sabrina casts a spell wishing for more excitement.

Episodes.Title: The Great Mistake
Episodes.Description: Sabrina finds herself in a "little" trouble when she sneaks out of the house after being grounded.

Episodes.Title: The Crucible
Episodes.Description: Sabrina is put on trial for witchcraft when her class visits historical Salem, Massachusetts.

Episodes.Title: Troll Bride
Episodes.Description: When Sabrina is tricked into marrying a troll, only a prince - a.k.a. Harvey - can save her.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina Gets Her License (1)
Episodes.Description: All of Sabrina's responsibilities as student, girlfriend and witch pile up on her as she fails her witch's exam and ends up at witch boot camp.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina Gets Her License (2)
Episodes.Description: Sabrina plans to escape from boot camp to be with Harvey.

Episodes.Title: Dummy for Love
Episodes.Description: Sabrina takes advantage of Vice Principal Kraft's attraction to Aunt Hilda.

Episodes.Title: Dante's Inferno
Episodes.Description: Sabrina learns not to date outside of her realm after a bad evening with a witch boy.

Episodes.Title: A Doll's Story
Episodes.Description: Babysitting becomes a test of ingenuity when Sabrina's bratty little cousin turns her into a doll.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina, the Teenage Boy
Episodes.Description: Sabrina can't understand boys and when she senses something between Harvey and Valerie, she turns herself into a boy but ends up dating Libby. Hilda also transforms into a man to try and get rid of Mr Kraft.

Episodes.Title: A River of Candy Corn Runs Through It
Episodes.Description: Valerie announces an unplanned Halloween party at Sabrina's who decides to whip one up and has to deal with her aunts' talking furniture.

Episodes.Title: Inna-Gadda-Sabrina
Episodes.Description: After Salem swallows a time-ball Sabrina's entire existence swirls back to the 1960's.

Episodes.Title: Witch Trash
Episodes.Description: After Sabrina's country cousins express their anger over Sabrina getting the family spell book, they magically lock the Spellmans and their guests in the house.

Episodes.Title: To Tell a Mortal
Episodes.Description: On Friday the 13th a witch can tell a mortal about being a witch because at the end of the day they will forget about their secret so Sabrina tells Valerie and Harvey.

Episodes.Title: Oh What a Tangled Spell She Weaves
Episodes.Description: Sabrina must learn that spells worded too generally affect her entire world. She also sends Salem and her Aunts to Merlin's castle.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina Claus
Episodes.Description: Sabrina meets the real Santa Claus named 'Bob' and has to fill in for him when he is injured.

Episodes.Title: Little Big Kraft
Episodes.Description: Sabrina turns Mr. Kraft into an obnoxious and irresponsible teenager and almost ruins the high school ski trip.

Episodes.Title: Five Easy Pieces of Libby
Episodes.Description: While working on a float with Libby, Sabrina casts a spell that keeps her away from Sabrina. The spell is reversed and they have to spend time together. Finally Libby turns into a puzzle that Sabrina has to solve.

Episodes.Title: Finger Lickin' Flu
Episodes.Description: Sabrina's magic accidentally gets transfered to Mrs. Quick who turns Mr. Kraft into a chimp.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina and the Beanstalk
Episodes.Description: Sabrina accidentally whips up a giant beanstalk and Harvey ends up on top of it being fattened up by a hungry witch.

Episodes.Title: The Equalizer
Episodes.Description: Roland the Troll is a magic policeman and steals Sabrina's heart after she misuses magic.

Episodes.Title: The Band Episode
Episodes.Description: Some bottled talent drinks make Sabrina's band (Harvey and Valerie) very hot, but also ruins their friendships.

Episodes.Title: When Teens Collide
Episodes.Description: Sunspots cause havoc with witches as Sabrina and Libby change personalities which Salem takes advantage of.

Episodes.Title: My Nightmare, the Car
Episodes.Description: Sabrina and Valerie share a car that Sabrina gets from the Other Realm that talks and prefers Sabrina.

Episodes.Title: Fear Strikes Up a Conversation
Episodes.Description: Sabrina erases her fears before reading an essay in front of a school assembly and her fears stalk the the school halls causing everyone to be afraid of the smallest things.

Episodes.Title: Quiz Show
Episodes.Description: When Sabrina complains about her Quizmaster he gets reassigned just before Sabrina's hardest test.

Episodes.Title: Disneyworld
Episodes.Description: On a field trip to Disney's Animal Kingdom in Florida, Sabrina, working to pass a critical test for her witch's license, accidentally turns Libby and Valerie into zebras.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina's Choice
Episodes.Description: When Sabrina plays one aunt against the other they decide to setup separate households and Sabrina has to decide between them.

Episodes.Title: Rumor Mill
Episodes.Description: In order to get her witch's license, Sabrina must complete community service in the Other Realm. She gets a job at the rumor mill, a place where rumors are started, and meets a guy named Dashiell.

Episodes.Title: Mom vs. Magic
Episodes.Description: Sabrina's plan to balance seeing both Harvey and Dashiell is disrupted when they meet each other by chance. They ask her to choose between them, while a hasty act leads to her being forced to make an even bigger decision.

Episodes.Title: It's A Mad Mad Mad Mad Season Opener
Episodes.Description: As Sabrina continues to avoid choosing between Harvey and Dashiell, the pair give her an ultimatum: choose one of them, or neither will stay with her. Meanwhile, her aunts inform that she is finally to receive her witch's license.

Episodes.Title: Boy Was My Face Red
Episodes.Description: To ease Valerie's embarrassment Sabrina casts a spell which helps Valerie, but the spell turns her face red.

Episodes.Title: Suspicious Minds
Episodes.Description: Sabrina gets jealous when Mr. Kraft's assignment calls for the students to pair up and pretend to be married and Libby makes sure that Harvey is her partner.

Episodes.Title: The Pom Pom Incident
Episodes.Description: Trouble brews between best friends when Valerie becomes eager to try out for cheerleading, even though Sabrina can't stand the squad's pom-pompous participants.

Episodes.Title: Pancake Madness
Episodes.Description: Sabrina makes a glutton of herself at school after tasting a substance that causes hopeless addiction in her family: pancakes.

Episodes.Title: Good Will Haunting
Episodes.Description: A thoroughly ridiculous Halloween episode finds Aunts Hilda and Zelda having run out excuses (after 500 consecutive years) not to attend their Aunt Beulah's Halloween party.

Episodes.Title: You Bet Your Family
Episodes.Description: Salem loses Sabrina and her aunts in a card game against a high roller.

Episodes.Title: And the Sabrina Goes To...
Episodes.Description: When no one acknowledges her achievements Sabrina casts a spell and ends upon her own awards show.

Episodes.Title: Nobody Nose Libby Like Sabrina Nose Libby
Episodes.Description: Rivalry between Libby and Sabrina moves onto a whole new scale in this parody of the '60s science fiction film Fantastic Voyage.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina and the Beast
Episodes.Description: Sabrina and Harvey decide to compete against Libby and her boyfriend for the title of cutest teen couple.

Episodes.Title: Christmas Amnesia
Episodes.Description: It's Sabrina the Grinch, increasingly grumpy in the face of her aunts' unflagging efforts to get her into the holiday spirit.

Episodes.Title: Whose So-Called Life Is It Anyway?
Episodes.Description: Sabrina gives Valerie's family a wishbone wish despite warnings from the Witches Council.

Episodes.Title: What Price Harvey?
Episodes.Description: Hilda and Zelda's zany cousin convinces the sisters to switch personalities, and gives Sabrina a cologne to use on Harvey in order to make him more ambitious.

Episodes.Title: Mrs. Kraft
Episodes.Description: Sabrina and Hilda are disturbed, not to say grossed out, by the growing intimacy between Zelda and Mr. Kraft.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina and the Pirates
Episodes.Description: Sabrina's aunts send in their magic for its annual overhaul, but when it is sent back, it ends up in the hands of three pirate prisoners they forgot to release years before, and Sabrina, also without magic due to a mishap, must save them.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina the Matchmaker
Episodes.Description: Cupid threatens to banish Sabrina to the Other Realm unless she manages to bring a couple together for Valentine's Day.

Episodes.Title: Salem, the Boy
Episodes.Description: Roland the Troll resurfaces in a new guise as a leprechaun, and chaos predictably follows. Having three wishes, Sabrina unwisely uses one of them to grant Salem's desire to be human again for a day.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina, the Teenage Writer
Episodes.Description: Sabrina's creative writing assignments aren't going well until she accidentally uses Hilda's magic typewriter to plot out a James Bond parody using her friends and foes as character models.

Episodes.Title: The Big Sleep
Episodes.Description: Sabrina wakes up Aunt Dorma from her hibernation who is unhappy and sends the Spellmans a house full of sleep inducing poppies.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina's Pen Pal
Episodes.Description: Sabrina's painfully shy pen pal turns out to be an Other Realm jewel thief in disguise.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina's Real World
Episodes.Description: The Witch Channel broadcasts Sabrina's life on national television; Hilda turns into a compulsive standup comedienne.

Episodes.Title: The Long and Winding Short Cut
Episodes.Description: After accepting help from an outside, Sabrina is banished to the Other Realm's Wild West badlands.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina the Sandman
Episodes.Description: Sabrina gets a job as a sleep-inducing sandman but changes her subjects' lives by altering their dreams.

Episodes.Title: Silent Movie
Episodes.Description: Harvey tells Sabrina he loves her, but under a self-imposed "silence" spell, she can't respond in kind and Aunt Zelda anxiously awaits a marriage proposal from Mr. Kraft.

Episodes.Title: The Good, the Bad and the Luau
Episodes.Description: Sabrina and her aunts travel to Hawaii for a family reunion, but when they arrive, Sabrina discovers that she will not be able to enjoy herself until she solves the family secret once and for all.

Episodes.Title: No Place Like Home
Episodes.Description: Sabrina goes to live with her father in Paris.

Episodes.Title: Dream a Little Dreama Me
Episodes.Description: Sabrina learns that she has been instructed to mentor a witch student, and it turns out that her student is the new girl at school, Dreama. However, Dreama's clumsy spells arouse Harvey's friend Brad's suspicions, revealing his true nature.

Episodes.Title: Jealousy
Episodes.Description: Sabrina turns green with envy, literally, after Harvey and Brad become best friends, triggering a case of Jealotosis - an intense green-eyed witch envy - when Harvey teams up with Brad instead of her to write an article for the school paper.

Episodes.Title: Little Orphan Hilda
Episodes.Description: Sabrina invites her fussy grandmother Lydia to visit, but the family gathering is not a success.

Episodes.Title: Spoiled Rotten
Episodes.Description: Credit-card carrier Sabrina catches get-itis and begins to spoil herself...literally, and tries to cure it by donating magic mementos to a yard sale.

Episodes.Title: Episode LXXXI: The Phantom Menace
Episodes.Description: It's Halloween, and Sabrina is having a ghoulish time adjusting to her new job at the coffee house.

Episodes.Title: Prelude to a Kiss
Episodes.Description: Sabrina enlists Dreama to zap her into two places at once after she agrees to help Josh study on the night of Harvey's big football game.

Episodes.Title: Aging, Not So Gracefully
Episodes.Description: Sabrina zaps on a skin cream to appear more mature after college-guy Josh shoots down a romance because of her age, but the fast-acting lotion ends up being a rapid-aging potion.

Episodes.Title: Love Means Having to Say You're Sorry
Episodes.Description: Consumed with guilt over kissing Josh, Sabrina runs herself ragged trying to cook up a way to get Harvey to forgive her without having to say she's sorry.

Episodes.Title: Ice Station Sabrina
Episodes.Description: Sabrina is unable to use magic to save the day after uninvited witch-hunter Brad joins her and Harvey on a doomed ski trip.

Episodes.Title: Salem and Juliette
Episodes.Description: Sabrina and Mrs. Quick uncover a scandal at school involving Mr. Kraft and misappropriated funds. Meanwhile, Sabrina finds Salem a date for his high school reunion, but it seems he is much more interested in her than she is in him.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina, Nipping at Your Nose
Episodes.Description: A Jamaica-bound Sabrina must spend the holidays with Mr. Kraft after she fools with Mother Nature and her snowy forecast.

Episodes.Title: Now You See Her, Now You Don't
Episodes.Description: Trying to lose weight to fit into a dress, Sabrina's Other Realm remedy makes her disappear.

Episodes.Title: Super Hero
Episodes.Description: Sabrina's sloppy spell casting turns Harvey into his childhood superhero idol, while Kraft quits school to become a world famous aviator.

Episodes.Title: Love in Bloom
Episodes.Description: Valentine's Day magic has Sabrina rushing to put an end to Josh's secret crush on her before she breaks Harvey's heart.

Episodes.Title: Welcome Back, Duke
Episodes.Description: Salem's war-criminal buddy Duke visits after completing his sentence as a cat, and finds his powers have grown a little hairy.

Episodes.Title: Salem's Daughter
Episodes.Description: Salem is heartbroken to receive a wedding announcement from his estranged daughter Annabele, who hasn't spoken to him in decades.

Episodes.Title: Dreama the Mouse
Episodes.Description: Sabrina has to fight a bad case of spring fever and deal with Dreama who has been turned into a mouse.

Episodes.Title: The Wild, Wild Witch
Episodes.Description: When upset with all the rules in her life, Sabrina is sent to an old west town that has no rules.

Episodes.Title: She's Baaaack!
Episodes.Description: Sabrina's bratty cousin Amanda shows up with plans to steal one of Sabrina's men.

Episodes.Title: The Four Faces of Sabrina
Episodes.Description: When Sabrina is accepted to different colleges, she is pressured by Josh, Harvey and Zelda to choose their favorite, but her indecisiveness and need to please everyone causes her to be torn apart -- literally into four different Sabrinas.

Episodes.Title: The End of an Era
Episodes.Description: Josh and Harvey are both fighting over Sabrina and they have to take a magical test.

Episodes.Title: Every Witch Way but Loose
Episodes.Description: Sabrina goes to college and moves into an old house with roomies Roxie, Morgan and Miles. She finds out she can't live a completely normal life as a witch.

Episodes.Title: Double Time
Episodes.Description: Sabrina casts a spell to speed herself up. Zelda takes a position as a prof at the college.

Episodes.Title: Heart of the Matter
Episodes.Description: Hilda takes over the coffee shop while Sabrina casts a spell so she'll say yes to everyone who asks her out after turning down too many dates.

Episodes.Title: You Can't Twin
Episodes.Description: Sabrina runs into Katrina who steals her Other Realm passport and goes to the mortal world to wreck her life.

Episodes.Title: House of Pi's
Episodes.Description: Sabrina goes undercover at Morgan's sorority to land a newspaper reporter slot, but has second thoughts.

Episodes.Title: The Halloween Scene
Episodes.Description: Sabrina has a Halloween party at her old place and ends up counseling Frankenstein and his bride.

Episodes.Title: Welcome, Traveler
Episodes.Description: Sabrina insists that Miles get more social and he ends up in a cult where its leader claims to be a witch. Sabrina looks into it.

Episodes.Title: Some of My Best Friends are Half-Mortals
Episodes.Description: Zelda fixes Sabrina up with a male witch which is fine until she comes up against prejudice because she is half mortal.

Episodes.Title: Lost at 'C'
Episodes.Description: Sabrina is totally devastated when she receives her first C and then Zelda takes up with the same professor.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina's Perfect Christmas
Episodes.Description: Spending Christmas with Morgan's family is not as perfect as it seems.

Episodes.Title: My Best Shot
Episodes.Description: Giving Josh a confidence boost makes him quit his job at the coffee shop.

Episodes.Title: Tick-Tock Hilda's Clock
Episodes.Description: A visit from old friends who are now parents sets Hilda's very literal biological clock running at an alarming speed.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina's New Roommate
Episodes.Description: When Sabrina reluctantly takes in Zelda for a few days while Hilda's on a home remodeling binge, Sabrina and her roommates try to loosen up the tightly wound Zelda.

Episodes.Title: Making the Grade
Episodes.Description: Sabrina tries to right a wrong when she writes an article for the school paper exposing the preferential treatment given to school athletes.

Episodes.Title: Love Is A Many Complicated Thing
Episodes.Description: While on a Valentine's Day double date, Josh surprises Sabrina by telling her he's breaking up with Morgan, who's oblivious to the fact.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina, The Muse
Episodes.Description: Sabrina is flattered when her new boyfriend writes music about his feelings for her, but the pressure to inspire as his muse becomes a one-sided relationship.

Episodes.Title: Beach Blanket Bizarro
Episodes.Description: Sabrina's wild vision of her first college spring break turn squeaky-clean when her aunts ask '60s teen idol Frankie Avalon to put a spell on the trip that sets Sabrina and her friends in a world straight out of a '60s beach movie.

Episodes.Title: Witchright Hall
Episodes.Description: Sabrina's cousin Amanda is sent to live a year in the mortal realm at a school for maladjusted witches.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina, the Activist
Episodes.Description: Saving a historical building becomes Sabrina's new cause as she becomes closer with Josh.

Episodes.Title: Do You See What I See?
Episodes.Description: Paranormal-studies major Miles spots a flying car and gives a class presentation on it, but the students are less than thrilled with his UFO sighting.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina's Got Spirit
Episodes.Description: Miles brings a paranormal-energy detector into the house so that he can identify spirits, and it goes berserk near Sabrina.

Episodes.Title: Finally!
Episodes.Description: Josh and Sabrina host a singles night at the coffee house and get into an argument after his friend stands up Roxie.

Episodes.Title: Really Big Season Opener
Episodes.Description: Sabrina and Miles decide to produce a horror picture and some of the actors may be real monsters.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina's Date with Destiny
Episodes.Description: Josh returns from his summer in Prague and says that he's taking a job overseas.

Episodes.Title: What's News
Episodes.Description: Josh's newspaper job is taking all of his time away from Sabrina and she finds out that Morgan is dating Harvey.

Episodes.Title: Murder on the Halloween Express
Episodes.Description: Sabrina takes a holiday idea from Salem and brings her friends on the spooky Mystery Train for a Halloween adventure. There's just one problem: It's in the Other Realm. Sabrina soon learns that the mortals can leave only if she solves the puzzling mystery when she goes back into something out of a 1920 mystery movie.

Episodes.Title: The Gift of Gab
Episodes.Description: Sabrina and Roxie get their own call in college radio show. Sabrina is tongue tied while Roxie takes right to it. Sabrina then bows out and lets Roxie have the show.

Episodes.Title: Thin Ice
Episodes.Description: When Harvey needs help on the Boston College hockey team, she gets him skates from the god Mercury.

Episodes.Title: Hex, Lies & No Videotape
Episodes.Description: Josh gets Sabrina a job at the newspaper, but she wants to keep their relationship a secret so people don't think she got the job as the photographer's girlfriend.

Episodes.Title: Humble Pie
Episodes.Description: After Morgan spends all her money, borrows from her roommates and then gets cut off by her parents, Sabrina gives her a taste of magical humble pie.

Episodes.Title: A Birthday Witch
Episodes.Description: Great-aunt Irma comes to test Harvey's trustworthiness when she learns that he knows that Sabrina is a witch.

Episodes.Title: Deliver Us from E-mail
Episodes.Description: Katrina gives Sabrina a virus that turns her into an airhead. She also wants to start her own column in the paper.

Episodes.Title: Cloud Ten
Episodes.Description: Rejection on a garbage strike story sends Sabrina to the Other Realm for a trip to Cloud 10.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina and the Candidate
Episodes.Description: Sabrina is wrong in her expose on a shady politician.

Episodes.Title: I Think I Love You
Episodes.Description: When Sabrina tries to say "I Love You" after Josh professes his love, it comes out in a funny voice. The Love Doctor says that she has to tell him that she is a witch.

Episodes.Title: The Arrangement
Episodes.Description: Great-aunt Irma shows up with a witch named Peter that Sabrina is supposed to marry immediately. Peter doesn't want to get married and falls for Roxie.

Episodes.Title: Time After Time
Episodes.Description: Sabrina uses magic to erase Zelda's broken heart, but the change in history erases Sabrina.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina and the Kiss
Episodes.Description: Sabrina kisses an old boyfriend and Josh says that he doesn't mind, but Sabrina wonders.

Episodes.Title: The Competition
Episodes.Description: Sabrina is annoyed when Josh says that women can't play tennis so she gets professional and magical help. Zelda and Hilda coach Amanda for her witch's license.

Episodes.Title: I, Busybody
Episodes.Description: After Sabrina tries to give everyone advice it seems to backfire every time.

Episodes.Title: Guilty!
Episodes.Description: Zelda is being nominated for Professor of the year until they find out she went to college in 1873 and they fire her.

Episodes.Title: The Whole Ball of Wax
Episodes.Description: Sabrina finds out her mysterious stalker is her mother. Once they have contact as warned she turns into a ball of wax.

Episodes.Title: Driving Mr. Goodman
Episodes.Description: Sabrina gets into a minor car accident and the other party sues her for a fortune.

Episodes.Title: I Fall to Pieces
Episodes.Description: Hilda finds her true love at a food court and gets married.

Episodes.Title: Total Sabrina Live!
Episodes.Description: Morgan submits Sabrina's article to a contest and she lands a job at Scorch magazine. Zelda and Hilda move back to the Other Realm and Sabrina and friends move into their house.

Episodes.Title: The Big Head
Episodes.Description: Sabrina's first assignment at Scorch is to interview a rock star which Sabrina ends up teaching a bit of humility.

Episodes.Title: Call Me Crazy
Episodes.Description: First Sabrina thinks everyone considers her too young, then her babbling about herself and (oops!) magic has them thinking she's bonkers and finally an interview with Ashanti gives her some newfound respect.

Episodes.Title: Shift Happens
Episodes.Description: Nervous about an interview with a hip-hop diva causes Sabrina to cast a spell exchanging their personalities.

Episodes.Title: Free Sabrina
Episodes.Description: Sabrina's plan to catch a light fingered diva in the act lands Sabrina in jail.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina Unplugged
Episodes.Description: Sabrina gets caught using her magic on Leonard's web-cam. While in his computer trying to destroy the evidence she gets an involuntary makeover and winds up looking like a cartoon siren.

Episodes.Title: Witch Way Out
Episodes.Description: Sabrina decides to go out on a date as a mortal and entrusts her magic to Harvey. Her date only wants to put her in his zoo.

Episodes.Title: Bada-Ping!
Episodes.Description: Sabrina sees a concert of a pop star that is being blackmailed by a gangsters. Sabrina gets threatened by the same underworld character.

Episodes.Title: It's a Hot, Hot, Hot, Hot Christmas
Episodes.Description: The girls visit Miami for Christmas and have a run-in with Roxie's mom who gets accused of robbing their timeshare.

Episodes.Title: Ping, Ping A Song
Episodes.Description: The girls audition for a television talent show with a bit of help from Sabrina's magic.

Episodes.Title: The Lyin', the Witch and the Wardrobe
Episodes.Description: Sabrina gets a job for Morgan to provide clothes for a celebrity photo shoot, but in the end has to fire her.

Episodes.Title: In Sabrina We Trust
Episodes.Description: Their house must undergo an Other Realm magical systems check without Roxie or Morgan learning about it. Finally Sabrina uses her magic on Roxie to gain her trust.

Episodes.Title: Sabrina in Wonderland
Episodes.Description: Sabrina wants to know why she keeps running into the same guy and has to go through Wonderland before she can learn the answer.

Episodes.Title: Present Perfect
Episodes.Description: Sabrina casts a spell to eliminate all her flaws to make herself perfect.

Episodes.Title: Cirque du Sabrina
Episodes.Description: After Sabrina's room turns into a circus tent, she must walk up and down the tightrope until she finds a balance in life between boyfriend, friends and her job.

Episodes.Title: Getting To Nose You
Episodes.Description: Sabrina gets tongue tied around Aaron and turns herself into a smooth talker. Her duplicate Cyrano tries to steal Aaron and Harvey confesses his love for Sabrina to Roxie and Morgan.

Episodes.Title: Romance Looming
Episodes.Description: Sabrina makes the fates mad when she saves Morgan's life and Aaron confesses his love to Sabrina.

Episodes.Title: Spellmanian Slip
Episodes.Description: When bickering breaks out at Sabrina's dinner with her future in-laws she casts a harmony spell and everyone breaks out in song.

Episodes.Title: You Slay Me
Episodes.Description: After asking Cinderella for advice on her wedding, Sabrina literally turns into a monster about the preparations.

Episodes.Title: A Fish Tale
Episodes.Description: When Aunt Irma finds out that Sabrina is marrying a mortal she turns Aaron into a fish. The episode ends with Sabrina finding Harvey's note that says that he will always love her.

Episodes.Title: What a Witch Wants
Episodes.Description: The girls go on a bachelorette cruise into the Bermuda Triangle where witches lose their powers.

Episodes.Title: Soul Mates
Episodes.Description: On the day of her wedding Sabrina is still trying to find whether her groom or Harvey is her real soul-mate.

Entries.Title: The Witcher
Entries.Description: Geralt of Rivia, a mutated monster-hunter for hire, journeys toward his destiny in a turbulent world where people often prove more wicked than beasts.

Episodes.Title: The End's Beginning
Episodes.Description: Hostile townsfolk and a cunning mage greet Geralt in the town of Blaviken. Ciri finds her royal world upended when Nilfgaard sets its sights on Cintra.

Episodes.Title: Four Marks
Episodes.Description: Bullied and neglected, Yennefer accidentally finds a means of escape. Geralt's hunt for a so-called devil goes to hell. Ciri seeks safety in numbers.

Episodes.Title: Betrayer Moon
Episodes.Description: Geralt takes on another Witcher's unfinished business in a kingdom stalked by a ferocious beast. At a brutal cost, Yennefer forges a magical new future.

Episodes.Title: Of Banquets, Bastards and Burials
Episodes.Description: Against his better judgment, Geralt accompanies Jaskier to a royal ball. Ciri wanders into an enchanted forest. Yennefer tries to protect her charges.

Episodes.Title: Bottled Appetites
Episodes.Description: Heedless of warnings, Yennefer looks for a cure to restore what she's lost. Geralt inadvertently puts Jaskier in peril. The search for Ciri intensifies.

Episodes.Title: Rare Species
Episodes.Description: A mysterious man tries to entice Geralt to join a hunt for a rampaging dragon, a quest that attracts a familiar face. Ciri questions who she can trust.

Episodes.Title: Before a Fall
Episodes.Description: With the Continent at risk from Nilfgaard's rising power, Yennefer revisits her past, while Geralt reconsiders his obligation to the Law of Surprise.

Episodes.Title: Much More
Episodes.Description: A terrifying pack of foes lays Geralt low. Yennefer and her fellow mages prepare to fight back. A shaken Ciri depends on the kindness of a stranger.

Episodes.Title: A Grain of Truth
Episodes.Description: Geralt sets off with Ciri on a journey that leads him to an old friend. After the Battle of Sodden, Tissaia shows no mercy in her search for information.

Episodes.Title: Kaer Morhen
Episodes.Description: Seeking a safe place for Ciri, Geralt heads for home, but danger lurks everywhere — even Kaer Morhen. Yennefer's dreams could be the key to her freedom.

Episodes.Title: What Is Lost
Episodes.Description: Impatient with Geralt's methods, Ciri braves major obstacles to prove her mettle. Scheming and suspicion amongst the Brotherhood make Yennefer a target.

Episodes.Title: Redanian Intelligence
Episodes.Description: A guest at Kaer Morhen extends a guiding hand to Ciri — and an invitation to Geralt. On the run in Redania, Yennefer seeks safety below ground.

Episodes.Title: Turn Your Back
Episodes.Description: As a powerful mage joins the hunt for Ciri, she cuts a deal with Vesemir over his extraordinary discovery. Geralt explores the mystery of the monoliths.

Episodes.Title: Dear Friend...
Episodes.Description: A close friend is lost — and another found — as Geralt helps Ciri learn more about her power. Cahir warns Fringilla to focus on their primary mission.

Episodes.Title: Voleth Meir
Episodes.Description: Geralt turns to the bard Jaskier for help, Yennefer realizes just how special Ciri is, and tensions rise on the eve of Emperor Emhyr's visit to Cintra.

Episodes.Title: Family
Episodes.Description: Geralt faces off with a demon targeting his nearest and dearest while the most powerful players on the Continent ramp up their pursuit of Ciri.

Episodes.Title: Shaerrawedd
Episodes.Description: Geralt, Yennefer and Ciri journey to the far reaches of the Continent in search of a safe haven. King Vizimir puts his charming younger brother to use.

Episodes.Title: Unbound
Episodes.Description: A shocking discovery awaits Geralt after he obtains information on Rience. Ciri's sense of justice causes problems. Jaskier performs for a royal fan.

Episodes.Title: Reunion
Episodes.Description: Geralt seeks magical help from a family friend as Ciri and Yennefer clash over plans for the future. Philippa and Dijkstra scheme to get Vizimir in line.

Episodes.Title: The Invitation
Episodes.Description: Yennefer pitches a bold idea to the Brotherhood, Geralt strikes a dangerous deal with a ferryman, and Triss digs into the mystery of the missing novices.

Episodes.Title: The Art of Illusion
Episodes.Description: Yennefer and Geralt step out arm in arm and dressed to kill at a lavish ball, but all is not as it seems during a night of revelry and revelations.

Episodes.Title: Everybody Has a Plan 'til They Get Punched in the Face
Episodes.Description: Betrayal and bloodshed rock the conclave when the hunt for Ciri comes to a head. As sides are chosen and enemies unmasked, nothing will ever be the same.

Episodes.Title: Out of the Fire, Into the Frying Pan
Episodes.Description: Haunted by faces from the past, Ciri endures the ultimate test of survival on a desperate journey under the harshest of conditions.

Episodes.Title: The Cost of Chaos
Episodes.Description: After the fateful events at Aretuza, Geralt and Yennefer struggle to pick up the pieces and reunite their family as war comes to the Continent.

Entries.Title: The Witcher: Blood Origin
Entries.Description: More than a thousand years before the world of The Witcher, seven outcasts in the elven world unite in a blood quest against an unstoppable power.

Episodes.Title: Of Ballads, Brawlers, and Bloodied Blades
Episodes.Description: A tavern brawl puts Éile on a collision course with destiny, emotions get the best of Fjall after a close call, and a royal betrayal leads to bloodshed.

Episodes.Title: Of Dreams, Defiance, and Desperate Deeds
Episodes.Description: In need of coin to fund their quest, Éile, Fjall and Scían hatch a risky scheme that leads to a firestorm of trouble. Merwyn stumbles on a secret.

Episodes.Title: Of Warriors, Wakes, and Wondrous Worlds
Episodes.Description: After meeting Meldof and her beloved Gwen, the warriors put a perilous end game in motion as truths are revealed, passions kindled — and sacrifices made.

Episodes.Title: Of Mages, Malice, and Monstrous Mayhem
Episodes.Description: As Merwyn forges an uneasy alliance to achieve her plans for Elfkind, the battle begins in Xintrea, where Éile finds her voice and Fjall loses control.

Entries.Title: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
Entries.Description: A. S. (Ad Stella) 122 ― An era when a multitude of corporations have entered space and built a huge economic system. Suletta Mercury, a lone girl from the remote planet Mercury, transfers to the Asticassia School of Technology, run by the Beneritt Group which dominates the mobile suit industry.

Episodes.Title: The Witch and the Bride
Episodes.Description: A shy girl from Mercury enrolls in the prestigious Asticassia School of Technology and immediately bumps heads with top student Miorine Rembran.

Episodes.Title: The Cursed Mobile Suit
Episodes.Description: Before Suletta can take in her victory, she's surrounded and taken into custody on suspicion of utilizing forbidden GUND Format technology.

Episodes.Title: Guel's Pride
Episodes.Description: Miorine insists on helping Suletta in her rematch against Guel. But with his pride in tatters, Guel has no intention of losing a second time.

Episodes.Title: Unseen Trap
Episodes.Description: Much to everyone's entertainment, Suletta panics and flees when Guel suddenly proposes to her. But Chuchu from Earth House isn't amused at all.

Episodes.Title: Reflection in an Icy Eye
Episodes.Description: Hoping to uncover the Aerial's secrets, Peil Technologies orders Elan to investigate Suletta, who gets flustered when he invites her on an outing.

Episodes.Title: A Gloomy Song
Episodes.Description: Ahead of her duel with Elan, Suletta feels confused about his change of attitude. Her housemates help her augment the Aerial for better mobility.

Episodes.Title: Shall We Gundam?
Episodes.Description: When Suletta receives an invitation to a social event for new business startups, she decides to attend in hopes that Elan will also be there.

Episodes.Title: Their Choice
Episodes.Description: Miorine wastes no time recruiting her housemates for her new company that will handle Gundams, but they must first decide on a business plan.

Episodes.Title: If I Could Take One Step Toward You
Episodes.Description: Miorine rejects Shaddiq's business offer and challenges him to a duel. They agree on a team battle, but her side lacks mobile suits and pilots.

Episodes.Title: Circling Thoughts
Episodes.Description: It has been two months since the duel with Shaddiq. Little by little, the launch of GUND-ARM, Inc. is proceeding on track.

Episodes.Title: The Witches from Earth
Episodes.Description: The Earth House members arrive at Plant Quetta to retrieve the refurbished Aerial. Suletta worries about the misunderstanding between her and Miorine.

Episodes.Title: Keep Marching On Instead of Running Off
Episodes.Description: Suletta has to change her attitude if she's going to save Miorine and everyone else. Meanwhile, Miorine and Guel will fight to survive.

Episodes.Title: Envoys from the Earth
Episodes.Description: It has been two weeks since the attack on Plant Quetta. At first glance, it seems daily life at the school has remained peaceful, but a gag order has been imposed regarding the incident, and the members of Earth House feel suffocated. As preparations get under way for the next day's Open Campus event, a pair of transfer students appear before Suletta.

Episodes.Title: What They Wish For
Episodes.Description: Behind the scenes of the vibrant Open Campus, Suletta learns what Sophie wants to get from their duel. Nina, meanwhile, feels responsible for the situation. As they each pursue their respective desires and strategies, the Rumble Ring kicks off.

Episodes.Title: Father and Child
Episodes.Description: Pursued by the Benerit Group's garrison forces, the Dawn of Fold which perpetrated the attack on Plant Quetta is forced to evacuate its hideout. Guel, who was captured by Olcott, is now a prisoner at the hideout. Having slain his own father, Guel remains sunk in deep despair.

Episodes.Title: Cycle of Sin
Episodes.Description: The school is in chaos as a result of the Open Campus incident. The Benerit Group's coverup of the incident and its aggressive security operations on Earth have been reported to the public, and it decides to hold an election to turn the situation around.

Episodes.Title: Precious Things
Episodes.Description: Having learned of the connection between Prospera and Delling, Miorine decides to take over the Quiet Zero project in exchange for Suletta's liberation. Miorine's 17th birthday is imminent. Now the curtain rises on the final duel that will determine her bridegroom.

Episodes.Title: Our Empty Selves
Episodes.Description: Defeated in a duel, Suletta has suddenly lost both Miorine and the Aerial. To shake off her sadness, she throws herself into school life. Miorine is getting ready for the presidential election, just as she promised Prospera. But she is clearly worried as Shaddiq takes the lead.

Episodes.Title: Not the Best Way
Episodes.Description: Descending to Earth with the Aerial, Miorine holds discussions with the Earthians leading the protests. Given the grim situation on the ground, it seems peaceful negotiations will be almost impossible. Meanwhile, the members of Earth House are unable to cheer up the despairing Suletta...

Episodes.Title: The End of Hope
Episodes.Description: Guel learns that Shaddiq is the mastermind behind the kidnapping of Sarius.

Episodes.Title: What We Can Do Now
Episodes.Description: The Asticassia School of Technology has been devastated by Norea's rampage. The surviving students are forced to live in evacuation shelters as they wait for relief.

Episodes.Title: The Woven Path
Episodes.Description: Prospera and Ericht activate Quiet Zero.

Episodes.Title: Unrelenting Tenderness
Episodes.Description: Piloting the Calibarn, Suletta confronts Ericht head-on. Guel squares off against Lauda, who is burning with bitter hatred for Miorine. And amid the chaos of battle, a rocket carrying Miorine and the others makes its way to Quiet Zero.

Episodes.Title: May All Blessings Find Their Way to You, I'm Wishing It
Episodes.Description: Relationships that end and others that are formed anew. Sadness and joy. Violence and wishing for peace. Space intermingles everything as a younger generation finds its way in a world where what is right is only a matter of perspective.

Entries.Title: Maria the Virgin Witch
Entries.Description: During the Hundred Year's War between England and France in the Middle Ages, a powerful witch named Maria lives in a secret forest with her familiars. She hates the war around her, and will sometimes stir up trouble against the church that does nothing to stop it. Her interventions into the world, however, run against the plans of heaven, earning her the attention of the Archangel Michael.

Episodes.Title: Perfect Virgin
Episodes.Description: In the days long past, a girl sought to make the world a better place. She was a witch, and a virgin. The world she is about to weave has begun.

Episodes.Title: Against the World
Episodes.Description: Warring continues, and Maria decides to enlist new help, but her actions to help dissolve conflict have now attracted attention from the heavens.

Episodes.Title: By Faith, Not Arms
Episodes.Description: By Michael's words, Maria will lose her powers upon losing her virginity. With Ezekiel now in watch, a new figure decides to approach Maria.

Episodes.Title: Remember to Die
Episodes.Description: A new witch appears in front of Maria, imparting a different view onto her situation. Meanwhile, Ezekiel ponders over Maria and her actions.

Episodes.Title: Courage, Prudence.
Episodes.Description: While Bernard works on his agenda, Joseph consults Maria in concern for Galfa's well-being. This brings more thoughts to Maria of her actions.

Episodes.Title: Under the Rose
Episodes.Description: Joseph is tasked to convince Maria to stay out of an important battle that may bring an end to the war, but when she finds that he and Anna's father are involved, she decides to intervene nonetheless, with tragic consequences.

Episodes.Title: War Feeds on War
Episodes.Description: Despite ordered by Michael to kill Maria should she uses her magic in front of the people again, Ezekiel barely avoids to fatally wound her instead. Meanwhile, Galfa, who lost an arm during the battle, blames Maria for it and swears revenge on her, assisted by the church who views her as a hindrance.

Episodes.Title: Man is a Wolf to Man
Episodes.Description: Despite not fully healed, Maria returns home just to find that she is being blamed for the French defeat in the last battle and the sudden worsening of Martha's condition. Meanwhile, Brother Bernard conspires to bring her down.

Episodes.Title: With a Grain of Salt
Episodes.Description: Maria loses her magic and is captured for her inquisition. While Joseph and the others plan for her rescue, Bernard approaches Maria with interest.

Episodes.Title: I Hate and I Love
Episodes.Description: Maria’s friends go all out to save her before she is sentenced. Meanwhile, Joseph’s return to battle leads to an encounter with Galfa.

Episodes.Title: If You Wish to Be Loved, Love
Episodes.Description: Joseph and Galfa face each other in a bitter duel. Maria finally arrives on scene and what follows is something not even she could have expected.

Episodes.Title: Love Conquers All
Episodes.Description: Amid a tense showdown against Archangel Michael, the final judgment of Maria’s actions is passed and her ultimate fate revealed.

Entries.Title: The Witch
Entries.Description: The story of a woman who is kicked out of her village and called a "witch" when the men that she likes get hurt or die, and a man who risks his life to try to save her from the law of death.

Episodes.Title: The Female Student
Episodes.Description: Dong-jin runs into Mi-jung, the girl who was branded as a witch in their high school. He follows her to her home without realizing it and sees how she's still suffering from the curse she's rumoured to have. Dong-jin decides to find out the law of the curse so he can help lift it and save Mi-jung.

Episodes.Title: Witch Park Mi-jung
Episodes.Description: Mi-jung, who couldn't stand the rumour of her being a witch and the boys from the same school getting hurt and dying, drops out of school. But the same rumour spreads in her village, leaving her no choice but to hide from everyone. Her father decides to take her to Seoul, but an unfortunate accident kills her father as well.

Episodes.Title: Coincidence
Episodes.Description: Dong-jin joins the statistics class and befriends Joong-hyuk at university, and they become best friends. He writes a statistics report to prove Park Mi-jung is not a witch, gaining the professor's attention. Dong-jin returns home during school break but learns the villagers have ousted Mi-jung from the village, breaking his heart. After graduating, he gets a job with Shine Solutions and becomes successful.

Episodes.Title: Error of Statistics
Episodes.Description: The statistics report Dong-jin wrote returns to him after his mother's death, and a battle within himself begins. He takes time off work and finds a place to live next to Mi-jung to get closer. Meanwhile, a victim of Dong-jin's work comes to get his vengeance, which makes him realize numbers aren't the answers to everything. Afterward, he returns to his hometown to find clues that will break Mi-jung's witch's curse.

Episodes.Title: The Law of Death
Episodes.Description: Dong-jin returns to Taebaek in search of a clue that could break the witch’s curse on Mi-jung. With the support of his friends, he meticulously compiles information about the string of accidents and uncovers a disturbing pattern. As he digs deeper, he realises that he meets every condition of his hypothesis, leaving him filled with suspicion and uncertainty.

Episodes.Title: Means and Methods
Episodes.Description: To uncover the missing years in his investigation, Dong-jin reaches out to Eun-sil, the one person who has been close to Mi-jung since their university days. With her help, he uncovers more accidents and deaths tied to her, strengthening his theory. As the puzzle pieces fall into place, Dong-jin realises the only way truly to validate his findings is to put himself to the ultimate test.

Episodes.Title: Data Validation
Episodes.Description: Dong-jin takes on a delivery job at the supermarket where Mi-jung regularly shops. Every Tuesday, as he delivers her orders, he begins to test the theory he's been developing about her. Gradually, he pushes the boundaries of his own rules, discovering just how dangerous it can be to remain within a ten-meter radius of her. Yet, despite the growing risks, his deepening desire to be closer to her and to linger in her presence threatens to draw him into ever greater peril.

Episodes.Title: Lee Dong Jin
Episodes.Description: Aware of the dire consequences of getting too close for too long, Dong-jin plunges into the river in a desperate attempt to save himself. However, Mi-jung recognises him, intensifying the danger he's already in. As he recovers in the hospital, Dong-jin turns to Producer Heo, seeking her help to identify a key variable in his hypothesis that might hold the solution he is desperately searching for.

Entries.Title: High Potential
Entries.Description: Morgan is a single mom with an exceptional mind, whose unconventional knack for solving crimes leads to an unusual and unstoppable partnership with a by-the-book seasoned detective.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: A single mom with an exceptional mind is recruited to the LAPD Major Crimes unit, where her unconventional knack for solving crimes leads to an unusual and unstoppable partnership with a by-the-book seasoned detective.

Episodes.Title: Dancers in the Dark
Episodes.Description: As Morgan and the detectives adjust to her new role as a consultant, they investigate the attempted murder of a tap dancer and discover things are not quite as they seem. Meanwhile, Ava learns more about her father, and Morgan surprises her kids.

Episodes.Title: Dirty Rotten Scoundrel
Episodes.Description: Morgan's intellect and cleaning experience prove useful when the detectives are called to a hotel room murder scene, eventually uncovering the victim's many cons. Morgan navigates Ava's dating while Soto reveals details about Roman's disappearance.

Episodes.Title: Survival Mode
Episodes.Description: Morgan is excited to get her official LAPD badge despite Karadec's reluctance. The detectives work tirelessly on an emotional missing children case, which hits close to home for Morgan and sends her mind into overdrive.

Episodes.Title: Croaked
Episodes.Description: The team investigates the death of an exotic animal veterinarian, uncovering a complicated love triangle in the process. Work interferes with Karadec's dating life, while Morgan follows a parental hunch about her teenage daughter and snoops on Ava.

Episodes.Title: Hangover
Episodes.Description: A wild office party at a high-profile medical technology startup leads to the shocking murder of the founder and CEO, and Morgan and the team are on the case. Meanwhile, a new co-worker at the precinct catches Morgan's eye.

Episodes.Title: One of Us
Episodes.Description: Morgan agrees to show Ava around the LAPD, but things quickly take a dangerous turn when the precinct is held hostage by the friends of a recently convicted man. Can Morgan and the detectives outsmart their captors and lead everyone to safety?

Episodes.Title: Obsessed
Episodes.Description: The team investigates a mysterious young girl who was found attacked on a beach. Meanwhile, Morgan begins to let her guard down on her date with Tom, and Soto comes one step closer to finding out what happened to Roman.

Episodes.Title: The RAMs
Episodes.Description: A famous baseball newscaster is murdered, and the team is on the case. Meanwhile, Soto and Morgan meet with a potential lead to discuss Roman's disappearance, and Tom has some personal news to share with Morgan.

Episodes.Title: Chutes and Murders
Episodes.Description: A nanny is found bludgeoned to death in the park. Elsewhere, Morgan interferes when Elliot admits to not being invited to his classmate’s party.

Episodes.Title: The Sauna at the End of the Stairs
Episodes.Description: Soto reopens an old murder case in the famous Donovan family, determined to uncover the true killer in classic “whodunit” style.

Episodes.Title: Partners
Episodes.Description: The FBI joins the investigation into the murder of a controversial tech magnate, forcing Karadec to reunite with his former partner. Meanwhile, Ludo becomes overwhelmed with his increasing childcare duties.

Episodes.Title: Let's Play
Episodes.Description: An anonymous tip to the LAPD sparks an unusual multiple-victim kidnapping investigation, forcing the team to rely on board games and puzzles to track down their suspect.

Entries.Title: Supernatural
Entries.Description: When they were boys, Sam and Dean Winchester lost their mother to a mysterious and demonic supernatural force. Subsequently, their father raised them to be soldiers. He taught them about the paranormal evil that lives in the dark corners and on the back roads of America ... and he taught them how to kill it. Now, the Winchester brothers crisscross the country in their '67 Chevy Impala, battling every kind of supernatural threat they encounter along the way.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description:
Two brothers, Sam and Dean Winchester,  witness their mother's paranormal death as children and grow up trained  to fight by a distraught father who wants nothing more then to hunt  down the thing that killed his wife. Sam escapes to college to start a  new, normal life, but gets pulled back in after Dean shows up on his  doorstep to tell him their father is missing.

Following clues from an  eerie phone message from him, the boys travel to a small town and  encounter a vengeful spirit called the "Woman in White" who then starts  to haunt Sam.

Episodes.Title: Wendigo
Episodes.Description: Sam and Dean follow the coordinates  left in their father's journal and land in the middle of the woods where  they investigate the disappearance of several campers. The two brothers  soon learn they are dealing with a Wendigo, a creature made famous in  Native America legends. A Wendigo is a former human whose cannibalism  has transformed him into a creature with superhuman strength and speed  that feasts on human flesh.

Episodes.Title: Dead in the Water
Episodes.Description: Sam and Dean investigate a series of  mysterious drownings written off as suicides. They discover the spirit  is an angry little boy with the power to travel through water who is  taking revenge on certain town inhabitants for a dark secret buried long  ago. Dean forms a bond with a young boy who seems to have the power of  premonition.

Episodes.Title: Phantom Traveler
Episodes.Description: On TransNational flight 2485, a man possessed by the spirit of the  Phantom Traveler causes the plane to crash, leaving only five survivors  left alive. Sam and Dean must exorcise  the angry spirit before it attacks the survivors. The brothers realize  the only way to do that is to take the battle to the skies.

Episodes.Title: Bloody Mary
Episodes.Description: In suburban Nebraska, a group of partying high school teens jokingly  dare their friend Charlie to look into  the mirror and repeat "Bloody Mary, Bloody Mary, Bloody Mary," not  knowing this will unleash a series of mysterious murders. Sam and Dean realize that Bloody Mary has the  power to travel through all reflective surfaces when she is hunting a  victim. Worried that teens are accidentally summoning Bloody Mary, Sam  and Dean race to destroy the violent spirit before she can kill again.

Episodes.Title: Skin
Episodes.Description: Sam and Dean come to the aid of Sam's  old college buddy after he is accused of a murder he swears he didn't  commit. The brothers discover a shapeshifter is adopting the likenesses  of others and murdering people. The brothers' race to stop the  shapeshifter takes a terrifying turn when he shifts into the likeness of  Dean.

Episodes.Title: Hook Man
Episodes.Description: The infamous "Hook Man," a vengeful spirit who kills his victims with a shiny hook that serves as his hand, terrorizes a small college town in Iowa. Sam and Dean learn that all the victims are connected to the daughter of a local minister and race to find and destroy the Hook Man's bones before he comes for them.

Episodes.Title: Bugs
Episodes.Description: After a construction worker is killed by insects burrowing into his  brain, Sam and Dean investigate the  town's history and find that the new housing development is being built  on sacred Indian land. The Indians put a curse on the land after their  reservation had been ravished and destroyed. Sam and Dean must find a  way to survive and kill the deadly swarm of bees, locusts, spiders and  beetles.

Episodes.Title: Home
Episodes.Description: Sam is haunted by a vision of a woman trapped in his  childhood house and convinces a reluctant Dean that they  need to go home. Upon arrival, they meet the woman in Sam's premonition  and she reveals that the house is haunted. Looking into their personal  history, the brothers discover their father had visited a psychic after their mother's  death and they turn to the same woman for answers of their own.  Together they discover a malevolent poltergeist has inhabited the house  and set out to exorcise it, but are blindsided when another unseen  spirit steps in.

Episodes.Title: Asylum
Episodes.Description: Sam and Dean investigate an abandoned  sanitarium and discover that when the hospital was open, the patients  held a revolt against the cruel and unusual punishments inflicted by the  head doctor. While the brothers search the premises for four lost  college students, the tortured spirits cause them to go insane, turning  Dean against Sam.

Episodes.Title: Scarecrow
Episodes.Description: Sam and Dean finally make contact with their father,  but he tells them to stop looking for him and sends them on another  ghost-hunting job. Frustrated with their father's evasiveness, Sam sets  out alone to find him while Dean stays back to obey his father. Dean  investigates a small town in Indiana where couples have gone missing the  same day each year and discovers the farmers are sacrificing them to a  Pagan God who takes the form of a scarecrow.

Episodes.Title: Faith
Episodes.Description: While battling a demon, Dean is electrocuted, resulting  in permanent damage to his heart and leaving him with only a couple of  months to live. A despondent Sam searches desperately  for a way to save his brother and believes he may have found an answer  through a preacher who claims to heal the incurable. However, Dean and  Sam discover that the preacher is getting help from the Grim Reaper who  is trading one life for another he feels is less worthy.

Episodes.Title: Route 666
Episodes.Description: Dean is contacted by his first love Cassie, an African-America girl, who asks him to come to  Mississippi to investigate a string of racially motivated murders. Each  murder is linked to a mysterious truck that seems to have no driver and  leave no tracks. Sam is stunned to see this new side  of his brother as Dean struggles to come to grips with the residual  feelings he has for Cassie.

Episodes.Title: Nightmare
Episodes.Description: Sam has a premonition in which a man is killed, but  the murder is made to look like a suicide. Sam convinces Dean that they must investigate the case, but the two are puzzled  when they fail to find anything that indicates that the death was  supernatural in nature. That is, until they find out that Max, the reclusive son of the first victim, has been using his  recently acquired power of telekinesis to kill the family members that  once abused him. Sam also discovers Max's mother was killed by the same  fiery demon that took his own mom.

Episodes.Title: The Benders
Episodes.Description: Sam and Dean head to Minnesota where a  young boy witnesses a man vanish into thin  air. Upon searching for clues, Sam is abducted by what he assumes is a  supernatural being, and Dean is left to search frantically for his  brother. However, both are stunned when they realize the kidnappers are  human, and using the captives as human prey for a twisted hunting  expedition.

Episodes.Title: Shadow
Episodes.Description: Sam has a reunion with a girl he once met, Meg, but it turns out that she is using the brothers to lure their father John to his doom.

Episodes.Title: Hell House
Episodes.Description: Sam and Dean investigate the case of a maniacal ghost inhabiting a long abandoned Texas farmhouse known as "Hell House." They believe the ghost is the spirit of a deceased Depression-era farmer who killed his family, but they soon realize it is something far more powerful.

Episodes.Title: Something Wicked
Episodes.Description: Sam and Dean battle a Shtriga, a witch that sneaks into childrens' bedrooms and sucks the lives out of them. Dean must relive his childhood when he remembers that he encountered the Shtriga years ago.

Episodes.Title: Provenance
Episodes.Description: The Winchesters must deal with a dangerous spirit bound to an old family portrait that brings misfortune and death to anyone who buys it.

Episodes.Title: Dead Man's Blood
Episodes.Description: To obtain a mystic gun capable of destroying the demon that killed their mother, Sam and Dean must team up with their father John and face off against vampires.

Episodes.Title: Salvation
Episodes.Description: John has realized where the demon will strike next and the Winchesters head there to stop the next killing. But Meg begins killing John's friends and demands the Colt or she'll keep going until everyone John knows is dead.

Episodes.Title: Devil's Trap
Episodes.Description: When Meg boasts that John is her prisoner, the boys visit a friend of their father's to get information about demonic possessions and ways to trap a demon. It turns out Meg is not what she appears.

Episodes.Title: In My Time of Dying
